lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: Good day, Commander.
Huh?

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: May I ask why you are behaving this way all of a sudden?
Oh, you changed your profile picture?

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: Just a moment.
Brid doesn't respond for a moment.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: Ah,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: that's right.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I just remembered how Soline was pestering me

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: to change it a little while ago,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: so I guess she went ahead and changed it herself.
You didn't notice it changed?

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: No,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I didn't notice until you pointed it out.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I don't usually pay much attention to such details.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: You're remarkably observant to have noticed it immediately, Commander.
Isn't it obvious that your profile picture has changed?

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I honestly didn't notice.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: A while ago, in the group chat with Soline and Diesel,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I didn't even realize they had changed their profile pictures.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: What matters is the conversation,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: not profile pictures.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: However, Soline and Diesel seem to think differently.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: What about you, Commander?

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: Do you think profile pictures are important?
Of course.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I'd like to hear the reasoning for your answer.
It's a picture that represents you.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I hadn't thought of it that way.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: But now that I consider it, you're right.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: When interacting with strangers,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: the first thing they notice is your profile picture.
Yeah,
I'm glad you changed it. It looks really nice.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I should make a point of personally thanking Soline,

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: and I also appreciate your kind words.

lines.speaker: brid_w
lines.text: I will be in touch again soon.
